title: Conflicting Product Sheets and Missing Packaging Data: Personal Care Agent Exceptions
summary: Two approved files give different case dimensions for one lotion: the Genie holds both values, flags the packaging level and waits for the owner.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Personal-care document agents should stop at conflicting product sheets, unclear packaging levels, and absent approved specifications. Keep candidate sources and their versions visible, then ask the owner to establish the authoritative value. A newer upload or a similar product is not enough to resolve the conflict.


Explore the complete[personal care integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/personal-care) for the systems and processes around this guide.
